skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply multivariate statistical analysis techniques to real-world data using software tools such as SPSS, R, and Microsoft Excel.
Prepare and clean data for statistical analysis.
Proficient in using statistical software tools such as SPSS, R, and Microsoft Excel.
Design and conduct research projects, including data collection, analysis, and reporting.
Analyze and interpret complex data sets to draw meaningful conclusions.
Work effectively in teams to complete research projects.
Effectively communicate research findings through written reports and oral presentations.
Solve complex problems using statistical methods and software tools.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently and apply new knowledge to practical situations.
Understand and adhere to ethical guidelines in research and data analysis.
